About the Role
Owns the employee lifecycle - onboarding, transitions and offboarding - blending empathy with execution so every touchpoint reflects our culture, efficiency and care. You will partner with HR Business Partners, IT, Workplace and Finance to deliver accurate processes and experiences that keep employees confident, connected and supported from Day 1.

Responsibilities
1. Onboarding & Assimilation
-
Own the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle, from pre-boarding to post-joining assimilation, with accuracy, compliance and a strong Day 1 experience.
-
Run orientation sessions on mission, culture and structure, and coordinate with IT, Workplace and HR on Day 1 readiness.
-
Facilitate assimilation programmes - new-joiner connects, check-ins, buddy programmes and milestone feedback.
-
Maintain a feedback-driven onboarding framework, using HR automation, AI-assisted drafting and self-service chatbots to cut manual effort and turnaround.
2. Offboarding & Exit Management
-
Manage offboarding end-to-end, from resignation to last working day, tracking timelines and process steps.
-
Coordinate clearance across IT, Finance, Workplace, HR Shared Services and reporting managers through to completion.
-
Issue exit documentation (resignation acceptance, relieving and experience letters) accurately and on time, and prepare and validate final settlement inputs for payroll within cut-offs.
-
Conduct exit interviews where applicable, capturing feedback and attrition trends to inform retention.
3. HR Operations & Data Governance
-
Maintain accuracy and integrity of employee data across HRIS and onboarding platforms.
-
Support lifecycle transactions - confirmations, internal transfers and related documentation.
-
Ensure compliance and audit readiness through timely updates and report validation.
-
Generate MIS and dashboard reports for reviews, using automation to streamline recurring outputs.
4. Engagement & Partnering
-
Drive site-level engagement, culture-building, celebrations and recognition that reinforce belonging.
-
Track engagement metrics and feedback to spot trends, using analytics tools to speed up sentiment analysis.
-
Partner with the HR Business Partner on lifecycle initiatives, pulse surveys and location-level interventions, providing on-ground operational support to employees and managers.
-
Work with Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT and Workplace to ensure smooth, accountable process delivery.
Skills
- HR Tools proficiency: Hands-on experience with Darwinbox, Fresh Services and MS Suite.
- Operational excellence: Strong coordination, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities to deadline.
- Communication: Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills across diverse audiences.
- Data & AI judgement: Comfortable using HRIS, Excel and generative AI tools efficiently, with sound judgement on accuracy, data privacy and manual review.
- Culture champion: Empathy and energy to deliver people-first experiences in a fast-moving environment.
Experience and Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Industrial Psychology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.
- 2–3 years of experience for Associate and 3–5 years of experience for Senior Associate in HR Operations, Onboarding, or Generalist roles, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment.

title: Director - Solution Engineering
description:
About Zeta:
Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 
Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 
 
About the Role 
Zeta solves hard technology problems for financial institutions. We do not offer a single product sold repeatedly, but solutions assembled from our processing, issuing, payments, lending, core, and digital banking platforms to answer a problem a bank has been unable to solve with what it already owns. 
Banks do not buy platforms. They buy the belief that a platform will survive their hardest workloads,their integration mechanics, and their examiner. You are the person who builds that belief, deep enough that the bank's own architects will defend it in a room you are not in. 
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of the sales engineering function for Zeta's banking solutions business in the US. You will run technical discovery with institutions that have twenty years of accumulated systems, design the target architecture and the path to it, defend that design through enterprise architecture, security, and procurement review, and stay on the deal until it signs.  

Responsibilities
Deep expertise
-
Gain an in-depth and hands-on understanding of the full Zeta stack: processing and issuing across credit, debit, and prepaid, core banking, deposits, lending, payments, fraud, loyalty, digital banking applications, and our agentic AI capabilities
-
In depth here means equivalent to our Product and Engineering teams that actually develop the stack, with first-hand knowledge of the modules, APIs, low-code extension points, events, data model, and features
-
Hands-on means having used each of those interfaces, APIs, events, and features yourself, in the manner an actual customer is expected to use them
-
Know the deployment story cold: environments, residency, resilience, and the answers an institution's infrastructure and security teams will demand
Discovery and solution design
-
Run technical discovery inside institutions with large existing estates, and find the problem worth solving rather than the problem first described
-
Assemble solutions across multiple platforms into one proposition, and be the person who decides what is in scope and what is a later phase
-
Craft solutions that meet the customer's needs on the fly during calls and presentations, with the readiness to demonstrate them live
Reference architecture and coexistence
-
Produce the target architecture and the integration design against the institution's existing core, ledger, data, and channel systems
-
Design coexistence and phasing: what moves first, what runs in parallel, what is decommissioned and when.
-
Build the reusable reference architectures that let the next deal start from something
Demos and proofs
-
Build and maintain demo environments across the platform set, covering the workflows a bank actually runs rather than a feature tour
-
Design and run proofs of concept, bake-offs, and tabletop exercises against criteria you helped the customer write, before a competitor writes them instead
Enterprise evaluation
-
Own technical RFP and RFI responses, security questionnaires, penetration test and audit report reviews, resilience and exit planning questions, and vendor due diligence
-
Create technical diagrams, architecture illustrations, and visuals that make the response clear rather than long
-
Carry the technical case through enterprise architecture review boards, information security review, and procurement
Banking service provider channel
-
Serve as the technical counterpart to a partner's product and engineering leadership through evaluation, integration design, and launch
-
Enable the partner's own sales engineers and solution consultants to position and demonstrate our capability without us in the room, and keep that enablement current as the product moves
Competitive positioning
-
Maintain a working analysis of the field: incumbent full-stack providers with deep installed bases, modern-sounding platforms running on older cores under new ownership, the in-house build, and the systems integrator who proposes to modernize what the bank already owns
-
Know what each buyer already believes about that field, and position against the belief rather than the vendor. Understand where a competitor is genuinely better placed, and requalify rather than discount
Marketing and product
-
Work with Marketing to produce technical thought leadership: articles, whitepapers, video scripts, case studies, and webinars. Speak at industry forums and events, and support analyst engagement
-
Carry the field's evidence back into Product: what was asked for, what was doubted, what lost, and what the roadmap has to answer next
Key Performance Metrics 
Institutional sales cycles run in quarters, and the first eighteen months buy the right to be evaluated before they buy revenue. Success is measured in two parts: what you build, which is yours alone, and what you contribute to alongside sales and delivery.
What you build and own:
-
A reference architecture and solution library covering the recurring institutional problems we intend to sell against, reusable by a seller without you
-
Surviving enterprise architecture and information security review at multiple institutions, with the objection log and the answers written down and reused
-
Product feedback that changes the roadmap, traced to named deals
What you contribute to:
-
Establishing Zeta's right to play, measured by the number of qualified institutions that reach technical evaluation, and by inclusion in competitive RFPs and shortlists we were not previously invited to
-
Winning technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and bake-offs in competitive situations
-
Direct technical contribution to closing at least one seven-figure ARR contract, with a technically qualified pipeline behind it that has cleared architecture review
Experience and Qualifications 
-
12+ years of experience across technology and commercial roles, combining more than one of software development and engineering, product management, pre-sales, and customer success – ideally in a banking tech company
-
Substantial experience selling technology into banks or credit unions in the US, with a track record of carrying deals through enterprise architecture, information security, and procurement review
-
Breadth across the bank technology stack: core, deposits, payments, cards, lending, and digital channels, with genuine hands-on depth in at least two of them
-
Experience with core or platform migration and coexistence in a live institution, from either side of the table, is strongly preferred
-
A degree in computer science or engineering is essential
Skills
- Technical breadth with depth: command of the architecture, APIs, events, and data model of cloud-native banking platforms, across enough of the stack to assemble one proposition out of several of them
-
Architectural judgment: design a target state, sequence the path to it, and defend both against an institution's own architects
-
Coexistence design: knowing what can run in parallel, what has to move together, and how to say so to a bank that wants a single date
-
On the fly solutioning: understand the need, connect the dots, and solve live when the question lands mid-call
-
Sales acumen: knowing where a deal actually is, and the patience for evaluations measured in quarters that change sponsors halfway through
-
Communication: presenting technical concepts to non-technical audiences, and holding your own with engineers
-
Presentation and public speaking: a confident presenter in customer meetings, conferences, and analyst briefings
-
Ownership: the agency to thrive in a 0 to 1 motion, with no team beneath you yet and priorities that move

Zeta is building a new consumer banking product for the US market. The focus is learning fast which features drive adoption, engagement and retention — and building them well.
 
About the Role
You'll help grow the product through a steady cadence of experiments and feature launches. Each PM owns a business-outcome metric for one area of the product, and the roadmap that moves it. Example areas: onboarding and activation, engagement and retention, revenue, and trust and risk.
We need a hustler. The work will feel like a very early-stage startup: ambiguous problems, incomplete information, shifting priorities and no playbook. You'll bring structure to the chaos: find the answers, make the calls and get things shipped.

1. Own a metric
- Own a business-outcome metric for your area, plus the guardrail metrics it must not trade away.
- Keep a ranked backlog of experiments and features, prioritised by expected impact (RICE, ICE or similar).

- Match the method to the traffic: A/B tests and holdouts at scale; fake doors, usability tests and cohort analysis at low volume.
- Size tests properly, report null and negative results as plainly as wins, and make the ship, iterate or kill call.
- Keep a running log of what was tested, what was learned and what changed.
3. Build features
- Take features from problem definition through spec, build, QA, launch and adoption.
- Write specs engineers can build from: flows, edge cases, failure states, event instrumentation and acceptance criteria.
- Work through technical design with engineering — APIs, data models, ledger and payment flows, third-party integrations — and make trade-off calls quickly.

- Define output metrics (acquisition, activation, revenue, engagement) and the input metrics that drive them (funnel conversion, feature usage).

- Work with compliance, risk, banking partners, operations and support so every launch meets regulatory requirements and can be supported from day one.

- Statistics and experiment design: hypothesis testing, significance, power and sample sizing, and common traps such as peeking and novelty effects.

- Ability to work through messy data sets and turn them into decisions.

title: Vice President - Sales & Business Development
description:
About Zeta:
Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 
Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 
 
About the Role:
Zeta is looking for a highly entrepreneurial VP of Sales & Business Development to help build the book of business across sponsor banks, BIN sponsors, agent banks, program managers, and fintechs. This is a 0-1 role that will be responsible for creating, qualifying, progressing, and closing high-quality opportunities across debit, prepaid, credit, lending, and adjacent banking technology propositions. 
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on business builder with strong existing relationships in the US banking, sponsor bank, and fintech ecosystem; the ability to open senior doors; and the commercial discipline to convert market access into qualified pipeline, active pursuits, and signed revenue. 

Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
-
Own prospect identification, segmentation, prioritization, and outreach across named accounts based on segment attractiveness, buying intent, relationship access, fit with Zeta’s capabilities, and likelihood of conversion
-
Open doors and establish trusted access to decision makers, sponsors, and influencers across banks, regulated financial institutions, program managers, fintechs, processors, networks, consultants, and other ecosystem participants
-
Build & nurture qualified pipeline that meets clear standards including named prospect, named buyer or sponsor, documented use case, estimated annual contract value, and next meeting or decision milestone scheduled
-
Drive the full deal journey for assigned opportunities spanning discovery, qualification, solution framing, pitching, pricing inputs, business case development, stakeholder mapping, procurement support, contracting support, and deal closure
-
Anchor pre-sales engagements in partnership with the sales engineering team to create & deliver demos, POCs, tabletop-exercises, solution workshops, discovery sessions, and other impactful formats that generate traction with clients
-
Support contracting, client onboarding, and early account activation to ensure a clean handoff from signed opportunity to delivery, implementation, and long-term account ownership
-
Participate in events and industry fora to acquire leads, drive visibility, and awareness of Zeta’s offerings & solutions
-
Maintain rigorous deal discipline through accurate CRM hygiene, weekly pipeline reviews, opportunity plans, stakeholder maps, next-step tracking, forecast updates and more
-
Contribute market intelligence, buyer feedback, competitor insights, pricing signals, and product input to help refine Zeta’s proposition, right to play, and right to win in this segment
Key Performance Metrics 
Success in the initial 18 months will be measured by:
-
Success in building qualified pipeline as measured by # of qualified opportunities, estimated annual contract value, documented use cases, named buyer or sponsor access, and scheduled decision milestones
-
Establishing Zeta’s right to play as measured by # of senior meetings, # of pre-sales engagements, # of active opportunities, and # of RFP or opportunity participations
-
Establishing Zeta’s right to win in this segment as measured by meaningful contribution to at least 2 USD 7-figure ARR client wins
Experience and Qualifications
-
15+ years' experience; with at least 5+ years as a partner or sales leader with a proven track record in building a multi-million $ book of business ground up in the US financial services sector
-
Significant experience selling to both banks and regulated financial institutions as well as fintechs at a banking technology company or IT services provider
-
Strong rolodex and meaningful inroads with decision makers at US sponsor banks & fintechs
Equal Opportunity
Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success
